title: Salmon Mayo Tobiko Gunkan
description: Compact nori cups filled with fully cooked salmon, mayonnaise and roe.

ingredients.name: Prepared, seasoned sushi rice
ingredients.note: Use the separate Sushi Rice recipe

steps: Cook salmon through, cool promptly and flake finely. Mix with Kewpie and scallions, leaving some salmon texture.
Using slightly damp hands, form compact oval rice portions about 25 g each. Cut nori into strips slightly taller than the rice.
Wrap one nori strip around each rice oval, sealing with a damp rice grain to form a raised rim.
Spoon on the salmon mixture and finish with tobiko. Assemble close to serving time.
notes: Tobiko or masago can be omitted, although the finished flavor and texture will differ.
This baseline yields approximately four rolls (or the equivalent nigiri, gunkan or hand-roll assortment), about six light servings.
Sushi rice is prepared and seasoned separately; the rice quantity here is its ready-to-use weight.
Salmon is fully cooked, including the very thin seared-slice variations; for thicker pieces, 63°C at the center is a conservative target.
